meta.titre: Vegetarian Diets and Food Choices: Types, Reasons and Meat-Free Meal Planning
meta.sous_theme: Types of vegetarian, reasons, protein complementation and nutrients to watch

source.epreuve_titre: GCE O/L Food and Nutrition past paper (Cameroon)

sections.contenu_markdown: Imagine a stall in Bamenda market piled with dry beans, groundnuts and soya. Some of the people who buy from it avoid meat because of their faith or their health, and many others simply cannot afford meat every day. The GCE asks why people become vegetarians, which kinds of vegetarian exist, and how a meat-free eater can still get enough protein, iron and vitamins. Marks are lost mainly by giving the wrong number of points or by mixing up a vegetarian with a vegan.

items: Proteins are body-building foods made of small units called amino acids.
Essential amino acids cannot be made by the body and must come from the food we eat.
Foods of animal origin include meat, fish, eggs and milk; foods of plant origin include cereals, legumes, nuts, vegetables and fruits.
Vitamins and mineral salts protect the body and help it to work properly.

sections.titre: Types of vegetarian, reasons for the choice and a safe meat-free diet
sections.contenu_markdown:
### What is a vegetarian diet?
A vegetarian does not eat the flesh of animals (meat, poultry and fish). Vegetarians are grouped by the animal foods they still accept.

| Type | Eats | Avoids |
|---|---|---|
| Lacto-vegetarian | plant foods and milk products | meat, fish and eggs |
| Lacto-ovo-vegetarian | plant foods, milk products and eggs | meat and fish |
| Vegan | plant foods only | every animal food, including milk, eggs and honey |

### Reasons for choosing the diet
Religious or cultural beliefs; concern for animal welfare; health (less saturated fat and more fibre); lower cost, since beans and groundnuts usually cost less than meat; dislike of the taste of meat; family habit; concern for the environment.

### Protein without meat
Protein of high biological value (HBV) supplies all the essential amino acids in good proportions. Eggs, milk, cheese, meat and fish give it. Among plant foods, soya beans are the best source of HBV protein, which is why they matter so much to vegans. Most other plant proteins are of low biological value because one or more essential amino acids is in short supply. Foods can be combined so that each makes up for the shortage in the other (protein complementation), for example beans with maize or rice, or groundnuts with a cereal food, eaten during the same day.

### Nutrients to watch
| Nutrient | Concern | Remedy |
|---|---|---|
| Iron | iron from plants is absorbed less easily than iron from meat | beans, green leafy vegetables and whole grains; eat a vitamin C food such as orange or tomato at the same meal |
| Vitamin B12 | found only in animal foods | vegans need fortified foods or a supplement |
| Calcium | milk and milk products are the main source | vegans can use green leafy vegetables and calcium-fortified soya milk |

variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question asks you to give, mention or state reasons or types, with a number.
variantes.contenu_markdown: Write exactly the number asked, one separate idea per line, each as a short sentence. Two lines that say the same thing earn one mark only: 'it costs less' and 'meat is expensive' are one reason. Add a few words of explanation when the mark scheme gives more than one mark per point.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When asked to plan, suggest or criticise a menu for a vegetarian or a vegan.
variantes.contenu_markdown: Check four things: a protein pair (a legume with a cereal) or soya; a vitamin C food to help iron absorption; a calcium source; and, for a vegan, a source of vitamin B12. A sound vegan meal is boiled maize and beans, a sauce of tomatoes and green leafy vegetables, and an orange to follow. Name the foods exactly and give the reason for each choice.

sections.enonce_markdown: A health club in Yaounde opens a canteen for vegetarians. (a) Distinguish between a lacto-ovo vegetarian and a vegan. (b) State four reasons why a person may choose to be a vegetarian. (c) Suggest one meal suitable for a vegan and explain why it supplies good protein. (8 marks)

etapes.action: Read the command words and the marks.
etapes.justification: 'Distinguish' needs a difference for both people; 'state four' needs four short points; 'suggest and explain' needs a meal and a reason.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Three parts: a difference, four separate reasons, one meal with its explanation.

etapes.justification: Say what each person eats and what the vegan also refuses.
etapes.resultat_markdown: A lacto-ovo vegetarian avoids meat and fish but eats milk products and eggs; a vegan eats plant foods only.

etapes.justification: Each reason must be a new idea, otherwise it earns no extra mark.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Religious or cultural belief; care for animals; health benefits; lower cost of plant protein.

etapes.justification: A vegan has no milk or eggs, so protein must come from a legume and a cereal, or from soya.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Boiled maize and beans with a tomato and green vegetable sauce, and an orange.

etapes.action: Explain the protein and check the count.
etapes.justification: Beans are short of some essential amino acids that maize supplies, and the reverse; together they cover the shortage. Tomato and orange add vitamin C, which helps the body to absorb iron from plant foods.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Four reasons counted, one meal named, one explanation given.

sections.conclusion_markdown: **(a)** A lacto-ovo vegetarian eats plant foods, milk products and eggs but no meat or fish; a vegan eats plant foods only and avoids every animal food. **(b)** Religious or cultural belief; concern for animal welfare; health reasons such as less saturated fat; plant protein usually costs less than meat. **(c)** Boiled maize and beans with a tomato and green vegetable sauce, and an orange. The cereal and the legume complement each other so that all the essential amino acids are supplied, and the vitamin C foods help the absorption of iron.

items.erreur_markdown: 'A vegetarian eats no animal products at all.'
items.pourquoi_faux: That describes a vegan. Many vegetarians still eat milk, cheese and eggs.
items.correction_markdown: A vegetarian avoids meat and fish; a vegan avoids every animal food.

items.erreur_markdown: Writing 'it is cheap' and 'they cannot afford meat' as two separate reasons.
items.pourquoi_faux: Both lines give the same idea, cost, so the examiner credits only one of them and you lose a mark.
items.correction_markdown: Give cost once and use another idea for the second line, such as religion or animal welfare.

items.erreur_markdown: Saying that all plant proteins are of high biological value, or that a vegan can never get good protein.
items.pourquoi_faux: Soya is a plant source of HBV protein, but most other plant proteins are short of at least one essential amino acid. Skilful combining gives the missing ones.
items.correction_markdown: Name soya as the best plant source and explain complementation, for example beans with maize.

items.erreur_markdown: Saying that a vegan can get vitamin B12 from beans and green vegetables.
items.pourquoi_faux: Vitamin B12 occurs naturally only in foods of animal origin.
items.correction_markdown: A vegan needs foods fortified with B12 or a supplement.

items.enonce_markdown: State whether each food may be eaten by (i) a lacto-ovo vegetarian and (ii) a vegan: groundnut paste, a boiled egg, yoghurt, fried plantain, grilled fish.
items.solution_markdown:
| Food | Lacto-ovo vegetarian | Vegan |
|---|---|---|
| Groundnut paste | yes | yes |
| Boiled egg | yes | **no** |
| Yoghurt | yes | **no** |
| Fried plantain | yes | yes |
| Grilled fish | **no** | **no** |

Fish is flesh food, so neither person eats it; egg and yoghurt are animal foods, which only the vegan refuses.

items.enonce_markdown: A vegan girl in a boarding school eats mostly cassava and plantain. (a) Explain why this diet is poor in protein. (b) Suggest two plant foods she should add and say what each gives her. (c) Name one vitamin she is at risk of lacking and say how she can obtain it.
items.solution_markdown: (a) Cassava and plantain are mainly starchy foods: they give energy but very little protein. (b) **Beans (or soya)** give protein and iron; **green leafy vegetables** give iron, calcium and vitamins; **groundnuts or egusi seeds** give protein and fat. Any two with their contribution. (c) **Vitamin B12**, which occurs only in animal foods; she can take foods fortified with B12 or a supplement.

items.enonce_markdown: Assume dried beans cost 800 FCFA per kilogram and beef costs 3\,200 FCFA per kilogram. A family wants to replace 750 g of beef in a stew by 750 g of beans. (a) Calculate the cost of each and the saving. (b) Express the saving as a percentage of the cost of the beef. (c) Explain why the family should serve a cereal food with the beans. (d) State one health benefit of replacing some meat by beans.
items.solution_markdown: (a) Beans: $0.75 \times 800 = 600$ FCFA. Beef: $0.75 \times 3\,200 = 2\,400$ FCFA. Saving: $2\,400 - 600 = 1\,800$, so **1,800 FCFA saved**. (b) $\dfrac{1\,800}{2\,400} \times 100 = 75$, so **75 per cent**. (c) Beans are short of some essential amino acids which a cereal such as rice or maize supplies, so the two together give a better protein. (d) Beans give more fibre and less saturated fat than beef, which helps to protect the heart and digestion.

items_markdown: A vegetarian avoids meat and fish; a lacto-ovo vegetarian eats milk and eggs; a vegan eats plant foods only.
Typical reasons: religion or culture, animal welfare, health, cost, taste, family habit and the environment. Give the exact number of different ideas that is asked.
Soya is the best plant source of HBV protein; other plant proteins are made good by complementation, for example beans with maize or rice.
Watch iron (add vitamin C foods), calcium (leafy vegetables, fortified soya milk) and vitamin B12 (fortified food or supplement for vegans).
When planning a meat-free meal, name a protein pair, a vitamin C food, a calcium source and give the reason for each choice.
